title: COVID-19 Crash (Feb–Mar 2020)
description: From the S&P 500's pre-pandemic record close to the March 2020 low: a global demand shock and a liquidity scramble, ended by massive Fed intervention. Shocks are real total returns (Yahoo Finance adjusted close) from 2020-02-19 to 2020-03-23.
source_name: Yahoo Finance (adjusted close); events cited in references
transmission: 2020-03-09: Oil price war: S&P 500 falls 7.6% in a day [1]
2020-03-15: Fed cuts rates to 0–0.25% and announces at least $500bn Treasury and $200bn MBS purchases [2]
2020-03-23: Fed announces open-ended asset purchases and corporate credit facilities (window end) [3]
